test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: India first participated in the Olympics in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1900**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's connection to the Olympics** dates back to the **1900 Paris Olympics**, the **second modern Games**.
 
• Calcutta (now Kolkata)-born **Norman Pritchard** became the **first Indian to take part** in an Olympics.
 
 
• He **ran in five athletics events** - the 60m, the 100m, the 200m, the 110m hurdles and the 200m hurdles.
 
• India** won its first Olympic medal** - **a silver in the 200m sprint**__, as Norman Pritchard crossed the finish line behind **Walter Tewksbury **of the United States.
 
• It made **Pritchard **the **first Asian-born athlete to win an Olympic medal**.
 
 
 
• 
 
**India first** sent its **official contingent of athletes** at the **1920 Antwerp Olympics**.

 
 
• 
 
Eminent businessman **Dorabji Tata** is credited with taking the initiative to form an ‘Indian Olympic Association’ to pick and train athletes who could participate in the 1920 Olympics.

 __
 
• 
 
The first-ever Indian Olympic contingent comprised **Purma Bannerjee **(100m and 400m), **Phadeppa Chaugule** (10000m and marathon), **Sadashiv Datar** (marathon),** Kumar Navale** and **Randhir Shindes** (both wrestling).

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Indian Olympic Association **was established in the year 1927.

 
 
• It is registered as a Non-Profit Organisation under the Societies Registration Act of 1860.
 
• As a member of the IOC and OCA, it is the Indian Olympic Association’s primary mission to develop, promote and protect the Olympic Movement in the country.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games**:
 
 
• The **first Olympic games** were reportedly staged in **Olympia in 776 BCE,** marking the Olympics' historical roots in ancient **Greece**.
 
• These ancient games were held every four years in Olympia to **honor the Greek god Zeus.**
 
• The **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** was founded in **1894**, and the **first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens in 1896**.
 
• Women competed for the first time at the 1900 Games in Paris.
 
• Women competed in every sport at the 2012 London Olympics for the first time, thanks to the addition of women's boxing to the Olympic program.
 
• The **1940 Olympics **are referred to as the **"Missing Olympics" **since they were moved to Helsinki, Finland, and eventually **abandoned due to World War II.**
 
• The Olympics have been held every four years since 1948.
 
• The **XXXII Olympics Games** were held in **Tokyo**, Japan.
 
• The **2024**, **2028 **and **2032 **Olympic Games are to be held in **Paris (France)**,** Los Angeles (USA)** and **Brisbane (Australia)** respectively.
